translation.ru: Ошибка при расчете критических параметров CO₂-этанола:
translation.tr: CO₂-Etanol kritik parametreleri hesaplanırken hata oluştu:

translation.ru: Ошибка при расчете общих критических параметров:
translation.tr: Genel kritik parametreler hesaplanırken hata oluştu:

translation.en: Show model data within experimental range
translation.ru: Показать данные модели в экспериментальном диапазоне

translation.en: The physical state of the system was not determined since no reference pressure and temperature were provided.
translation.ru: Физическое состояние системы не определено, так как эталонные давление и температура не были указаны.
translation.tr: Referans basınç ve sıcaklık verilmediği için sistemin fiziksel durumu belirlenemedi.

translation.en: Set the parameters and click Calculate to see results.
translation.ru: Задайте параметры и нажмите «Рассчитать» для получения результатов.
translation.tr: Parametreleri ayarlayın ve sonuçları görmek için Hesapla'ya tıklayın.

translation.en: Click the button below to display model data.
translation.ru: Нажмите кнопку ниже для отображения данных модели.
translation.tr: Model verilerini görüntülemek için aşağıdaki düğmeye tıklayın.

translation.en: Temperature was adjusted to the valid range (-20 to 200 °C).
translation.ru: Температура скорректирована до допустимого диапазона (-20 до 200 °C).

translation.en: Pressure was adjusted to the valid range (1 to 1000 bar).
translation.ru: Давление скорректировано до допустимого диапазона (от 1 до 1000 бар).
translation.tr: Basınç geçerli aralığa ayarlandı (1 ile 1000 bar).

translation.en: Set the CO\u2082 molar fraction in the binary CO\u2082-ethanol mixture. This determines the mixture composition for which critical parameters (Tc, Pc) will be calculated. A value of 1 corresponds to pure CO\u2082.
translation.ru: Установите CO\u2082 molar fraction in the binary CO\u2082-ethanol mixture. This determines the mixture composition for which critical parameters (Tc, Pc) will be calculated. A value of 1 corresponds to pure CO\u2082.
translation.tr: Ayarlayın: CO\u2082 molar fraction in the binary CO\u2082-ethanol mixture. This determines the mixture composition for which critical parameters (Tc, Pc) will be calculated. A value of 1 corresponds to pure CO\u2082.

translation.en: Choose the calculation method for critical parameters. Chueh-Prausnitz and Redlich-Kister are established thermodynamic mixing rules. Select 'Both' to compare their predictions side by side.
translation.ru: Выберите метод расчёта критических параметров. Chueh-Prausnitz и Redlich-Kister — устоявшиеся термодинамические правила смешения. Выберите «Оба» для сравнения прогнозов.
translation.tr: Kritik parametreler için hesaplama yöntemini seçin. Chueh-Prausnitz ve Redlich-Kister yerleşik termodinamik karıştırma kurallarıdır. Tahminleri yan yana karşılaştırmak için 'İkisi de' seçin.

translation.en: Set the system pressure (bar). This is used to compute the CO\u2082 density at the specified conditions via the Bender equation of state.
translation.ru: Установите system pressure (bar). This is used to compute the CO\u2082 density at the specified conditions via the Bender equation of state.
translation.tr: Ayarlayın: system pressure (bar). This is used to compute the CO\u2082 density at the specified conditions via the Bender equation of state.

translation.en: Set the system temperature (\u00B0C). Together with pressure, this determines the thermodynamic state for density and phase calculations.
translation.ru: Установите system temperature (\u00B0C). Together with pressure, this determines the thermodynamic state for density and phase calculations.
translation.tr: Ayarlayın: system temperature (\u00B0C). Together with pressure, this determines the thermodynamic state for density and phase calculations.

translation.en: Click to calculate the mixture critical temperature, critical pressure, and density at the specified conditions. Results appear in the panel on the right.
translation.ru: Нажмите, чтобы calculate the mixture critical temperature, critical pressure, and density at the specified conditions. Results appear in the panel on the right.
translation.tr: Tıklayarak calculate the mixture critical temperature, critical pressure, and density at the specified conditions. Results appear in the panel on the right.

translation.en: Generate a validation plot showing the predicted critical parameters across the full composition range, compared against published experimental data for the CO\u2082-ethanol system.
translation.ru: Сгенерируйте a validation plot showing the predicted critical parameters across the full composition range, compared against published experimental data for the CO\u2082-ethanol system.
translation.tr: Oluşturun: a validation plot showing the predicted critical parameters across the full composition range, compared against published experimental data for the CO\u2082-ethanol system.

translation.en: Configure the general solvent mixture. Select solvents from the database and specify their composition in mass or mole fractions. The mixture must include at least two components.
translation.ru: Настройте общую смесь растворителей. Выберите растворители из базы данных и укажите их состав в массовых или молярных долях. Смесь должна содержать не менее двух компонентов.
translation.tr: Genel çözücü karışımını yapılandırın. Veritabanından çözücüler seçin ve bileşimlerini kütle veya mol fraksiyonları olarak belirtin. Karışım en az iki bileşen içermelidir.

translation.en: Choose the mixing rule for estimating the mixture critical temperature (Tc). Different methods (e.g. Li, Chueh-Prausnitz) may give varying results depending on the mixture ideality.
translation.ru: Выберите правило смешения для оценки критической температуры смеси (Tc). Различные методы (напр. Li, Chueh-Prausnitz) могут давать различные результаты в зависимости от идеальности смеси.
translation.tr: Karışım kritik sıcaklığını (Tc) tahmin etmek için karıştırma kuralını seçin. Farklı yöntemler (örn. Li, Chueh-Prausnitz) karışımın idealliğine bağlı olarak farklı sonuçlar verebilir.

translation.en: Choose the mixing rule for estimating the mixture critical pressure (Pc). Available methods include Chueh-Prausnitz and Kreglewski-Kay, which differ in how they handle binary interaction parameters.
translation.ru: Выберите правило смешения для оценки критического давления смеси (Pc). Доступные методы: Chueh-Prausnitz и Kreglewski-Kay, различающиеся обработкой бинарных параметров взаимодействия.
translation.tr: Karışım kritik basıncını (Pc) tahmin etmek için karıştırma kuralını seçin. Mevcut yöntemler ikili etkileşim parametrelerini ele alış biçimlerine göre farklılık gösteren Chueh-Prausnitz ve Kreglewski-Kay'dır.

translation.en: Set the system pressure (bar) for density calculations.
translation.ru: Установите давление системы (бар) для расчёта плотности.
translation.tr: Yoğunluk hesaplamaları için sistem basıncını (bar) ayarlayın.

translation.en: Set the system temperature (\u00B0C) for density calculations.
translation.ru: Установите system temperature (\u00B0C) for density calculations.
translation.tr: Ayarlayın: system temperature (\u00B0C) for density calculations.

translation.en: Click to calculate the mixture critical parameters and density using the selected methods and composition.
translation.ru: Нажмите, чтобы calculate the mixture critical parameters and density using the selected methods and composition.
translation.tr: Tıklayarak calculate the mixture critical parameters and density using the selected methods and composition.

translation.en: Molar fraction of CO2 in the binary CO2-Ethanol mixture (0 to 1). A value of 0 is pure ethanol, 1 is pure CO2.
translation.ru: Молярная доля CO₂ в бинарной смеси CO₂-Этанол (0-1). Значение 0 — чистый этанол, 1 — чистый CO₂.
translation.tr: İkili CO₂-Etanol karışımında CO₂'nin mol fraksiyonu (0-1). 0 saf etanol, 1 saf CO₂'dir.

translation.en: Pressure at which to evaluate the mixture critical parameters (1-1000 bar).
translation.ru: Давление для оценки критических параметров смеси (1-1000 бар).
translation.tr: Karışım kritik parametrelerini değerlendirmek için basınç (1-1000 bar).

translation.en: Temperature at which to evaluate the mixture critical parameters (-20 to 200 °C).
translation.ru: Температура для оценки критических параметров смеси (-20 до 200 °C).
translation.tr: Karışım kritik parametrelerini değerlendirmek için sıcaklık (-20 - 200 °C).

translation.en: Method for estimating critical parameters of the CO2-Ethanol mixture. Chueh-Prausnitz is valid across the full range but overestimates at high CO2 fractions. Redlich-Kister corrects this overestimation. Both runs both methods for comparison.
translation.ru: Метод оценки критических параметров смеси CO₂-Этанол. Chueh-Prausnitz действует во всём диапазоне, но завышает при высоких долях CO₂. Redlich-Kister корректирует это завышение. Оба запускают оба метода для сравнения.
translation.tr: CO₂-Etanol karışımının kritik parametrelerini tahmin etme yöntemi. Chueh-Prausnitz tüm aralıkta geçerlidir ancak yüksek CO₂ fraksiyonlarında fazla tahmin eder. Redlich-Kister bu fazla tahmini düzeltir. Her ikisi karşılaştırma için her iki yöntemi çalıştırır.

translation.en: Method for estimating the critical temperature of the mixture. Kay (1938) uses molar averaging. Li (1971) accounts for molecular size differences. He et al. (2017) and Tang et al. (2025) are newer empirical correlations.
translation.ru: Метод оценки критической температуры смеси. Kay (1938) — молярное усреднение. Li (1971) — учитывает различия в размерах молекул. He et al. (2017) и Tang et al. (2025) — новые эмпирические корреляции.
translation.tr: Karışımın kritik sıcaklığını tahmin etme yöntemi. Kay (1938) molar ortalama kullanır. Li (1971) moleküler boyut farklılıklarını hesaba katar. He et al. (2017) ve Tang et al. (2025) daha yeni ampirik korelasyonlardır.

translation.en: Method for estimating the critical pressure of the mixture. Same approaches as for critical temperature, except the First Extended Chueh-Prausnitz method is not available for pressure.
translation.ru: Метод оценки критического давления смеси. Те же подходы, что и для критической температуры, кроме метода First Extended Chueh-Prausnitz, который недоступен для давления.
translation.tr: Karışımın kritik basıncını tahmin etme yöntemi. Kritik sıcaklıkla aynı yaklaşımlar, ancak First Extended Chueh-Prausnitz yöntemi basınç için mevcut değildir.
